segments.en: Joining us with the details, Bloomberg News reporter Rebecca Torrance, we had already reported that this round was underway, 30 billion raised at $1.4 trillion valuation.
segments.zh: 彭博新闻记者Rebecca Torrance带来详细报道。我们此前已报道本轮融资正在进行，以1.4万亿美元估值筹集300亿美元。

segments.en: Looks like the valuations coming off a bit.
What else do we need to know? There are some new names in this round. That's right, so we are now reporting that CO2 management is in talks to co-lead this round.
segments.zh: 还有什么需要了解的？本轮出现了一些新名字。没错，我们现在报道CO2管理公司正在洽谈共同领投本轮融资。

segments.en: That's alongside entities from the United Arab Emirates. We had reported that previously.
segments.zh: 这与阿联酋的实体一起，我们此前已报道过。

segments.en: The total round size is holding at roughly 30 billion as we reported at the end of September.
segments.zh: 正如我们9月底报道的，本轮总规模维持在约300亿美元。

segments.en: But the price has come down a little bit. We're now looking at a $1.25 trillion valuation.
segments.zh: 但价格有所下降。我们现在看到的是1.25万亿美元估值。

segments.en: As you said, that's $1.50 billion down from the previous price, which is reflecting some price in the broader markets.
segments.zh: 如你所说，这比之前的价格低了15亿美元，反映了更广泛市场的一些定价。

segments.en: A lot of people at the time when we first break the story were like, well, why is OpenAI doing this?
segments.zh: 我们最初报道时，很多人都在问，OpenAI为什么这么做？

segments.en: Aren't they going to go public? We have our reporting on when that might happen.
segments.zh: 他们不是要上市吗？我们有关于何时可能上市的报道。

segments.en: It all kind of played out around OpenAI's dev days where we actually got to speak to Sam Altman and Sarah Friar about it.
segments.zh: 这一切都围绕OpenAI的开发者日展开，我们实际上与Sam Altman和Sarah Friar进行了交谈。

segments.en: It seems like this is the investor's wanting to do this, rather than OpenAI needs the money.
segments.zh: 看起来是市场参与者想这么做，而不是OpenAI需要这笔钱。

segments.en: That's certainly how it's being positioned. I will say they do have these big compute commitments.
segments.zh: 确实是这样定位的。但我要说，他们确实有这些庞大的算力承诺。

segments.en: The work that they're doing is not cheap, so they can certainly use the money.
segments.zh: 他们所做的工作并不便宜，所以他们当然用得上这笔钱。

segments.en: And this money would be sort of a bridge to their public listing.
segments.zh: 这笔钱将是他们公开上市的一种过渡。

segments.en: They had originally planned to go as early as this year.
segments.zh: 他们原本计划最早今年上市。

segments.en: But now they're looking at next year, earliest.
segments.zh: 但现在他们最早也要看明年了。
